premises.text: Nonprofits remain tech-underserved and rely on pen and paper for volunteer and donation workflows
premises.evidence_span: Unfortunately, nonprofits continue to be underserved by our tech community

premises.text: Civic Champs mobile platform automates volunteer hour tracking and engagement capture with minimal staff effort
premises.evidence_span: a mobile platform that will fundamentally change how nonprofits operate and engage their supporters

premises.text: Integrated micro-donations use volunteer data and matching to convert volunteers into donors at the inspired moment
premises.evidence_span: solving one of the key missed opportunities of nonprofits, converting volunteers to donors

premises.text: Full-market database architecture differentiates from competitors serving only nonprofits, only volunteers, or only corporations
premises.evidence_span: We have three buckets of competitors. Those that serve nonprofits, those that serve volunteers, and those that serve corporations

premises.text: Monthly SaaS fees of $25–$450 monetize nonprofit CRM demand
premises.evidence_span: These clients pay between $25 to $450 a month

secondary_value.text: Serve corporations quantifying impact and foundations building agency capacity
